thesis: IC retains Planet as a Moonshot because market cap, DI, SL, AS and FS meet the configured conditions and the ex-valuation gate is 76.19. However, the unresolved long-term dilution Hard Veto blocks buy approval. The company has real recurring demand, a differentiated data archive and ample liquidity, but current per-share economics are not yet clean: working-capital effects, SBC, ATM issuance, warrants and fleet capex obscure normalized owner FCF/share. Final state: WATCH, 0% until dilution is cleared.

evidence.claim: Mechanical Moonshot conditions are met: market cap about $6.18B, DI 81.75, SL 82.5, AS 75.0 and FS 77.75; ex-valuation gate score is 76.19.
Demand quality is supported by FY2026 NDR 116%, recurring ACV 98%, FY27 Q2 revenue growth of 58%, RPO $753.1M and backlog $814.9M.
Financial survival is strong: cash plus short-term investments were about $865.4M against $460M convertible principal, and H1 reported FCF was positive.
evidence.value: Liquid assets ~$865.4M; convertible principal $460M; H1 FCF $21.3M

evidence.claim: Per-share economics remain unresolved because H1 SBC was $33.5M and the company raised $122.4M gross through ATM issuance plus $107.8M from warrant exercises.
The locked DCF is about $5.22 Bear, $15.94 Base and $39.36 Bull versus the frozen price of $16.99, so valuation is near Base and the modeled Bull is only about 2.3x current price.
Macro Overlay is 0.80x because real yields and policy rates are restrictive for a small-cap duration asset even though system credit conditions are not stressed.

counterevidence: The most plausible failure path is that Planet remains a capital-intensive satellite and government-contracting company rather than becoming a high-margin data/AI platform; revenue grows but normalized owner FCF/share does not.
AS only meets the Moonshot threshold at 75.0, and the locked Bull DCF is far below a 5x outcome, so true power-law upside requires economics beyond the current Bull path.
The strongest apparently bullish cash-flow evidence is partly affected by deferred-revenue and receivables movements, while SBC and new shares remain meaningful owner costs.
The harness may still understate upside if the proprietary archive plus AI layer creates high-margin monetization without proportional fleet capex, but that evidence is not yet mature.
unknowns: Normalized owner FCF/share after working-capital normalization, SBC and full replacement capex.
Long-run annual net dilution after sustainable positive FCF is established.
Steady-state gross margin and ROIC of sovereign satellite-services contracts.
Paid adoption, ARPU and margin contribution of the agentic AI layer.
falsifiers: After sustainable FCF breakeven, annual net dilution remains persistently mid-to-high single digit or higher instead of trending toward low single digits.
Owner FCF/share fails to compound over multiple years because fleet capex, SBC and working-capital normalization absorb revenue growth.
Recurring ACV/NDR and RPO conversion weaken together while customer concentration stays high, indicating the platform thesis is not broadening.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: RF and FS both leave this veto unresolved. Recent SBC, ATM and warrant dilution are material; buy approval requires evidence that net dilution falls toward low single digits as internally funded FCF matures.

key_kpis.name: Net dilution
key_kpis.threshold: Low-single-digit annual share growth or less after sustainable FCF breakeven

key_kpis.name: Normalized owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Positive and compounding faster than diluted-share growth after working-capital normalization

key_kpis.name: Recurring demand conversion
key_kpis.threshold: NDR/recurring ACV remain strong while RPO converts into revenue and gross profit with lower customer concentration

next_checks: FY2027 Q3 share-count, ATM usage, SBC and normalized owner-FCF bridge.
FY2027/FY2028 evidence that fleet capex intensity declines as revenue and gross profit scale.
Customer concentration plus AI/data-product paid monetization.
